bibl.title: "Lost in Translation": The Hellenization of the Egyptian Tradition.
bibl.seg: Rogério Sousa, "Lost in Translation": The Hellenization of the Egyptian Tradition.
Rogério Sousa, Maria do Céu Fialho, Mona Haggag & Nuno Simões Rodrigues (edd.), Alexandrea ad Aegyptum. The Legacy of Multiculturalism in Antiquity (Porto, 2013) pp. 230-264, figg.
bibl.note: Egyptian tradition in new context: the Alexandrian multiculturalism. - The Egyptian necropoleis in Greco-Roman times. - Egyptian temples in Greco-Roman period. - The Egyptian connection: demotic culture in the Greco-Roman period. - The Alexandrian Serapeum and the creation of a "universal" tradition. - Hermeticism as a multicultural "paradigm". - The universe in symbols: the impact of the Hermetic paradigm. - Alchemy as mystic cryptography. - Conclusion.
